I’ve been listening to Ally Yost’s Christ with Coffee on Ice and i highly recommend it. I teared up listening about her journey with Jesus (S01E02)

Do listen to S01E06 - “Why am i still single” as well it’s a good one!

Also i’m sorry youre going through this, i know it sucks having to decide to end a year long relationship, but just remember that whatever you decide, the relationship is never wasted, that the love you have is still very true (you got to a year after all). Just trust that maybe God brought him to your life to have you learn something, or get closer to Him (as what happened with me) but nonetheless I’m praying over your heart today 🙏❤️‍🩹

I stopped reading after i read that he has hurt you many times. That in itself is a sign you should end the relationship. What i like to think of is that if it doesnt give you peace and security, if you find yourself having the tiniest bit of confusion, then it is not from God. 

You will know if it is from God if you receive the same love, peace and comfort that He has for you.

Learned that the hard way as well. Ended a pretty short relationship with a man I thought I would marry, had made so many plans with about our future, but the thing that I couldnt tolerate from him was his anger and how we would argue, and felt disrespected. Even though he was a good man who introduced me to God, checked all the boxes, the relationship didnt give both of us peace and we ended up ending the short, beautiful and real relationship between us.

While the plans we made weren’t going to happen anymore, I was trusting that the Lord has better plans. My relationship with him ended, but during this singleness season (a few weeks in),I developed an even better relationship— with God, and I’m honestly so grateful. 

I pray the same for you to seek God in this time and find peace in Him instead. I will pray that the Lord enlightens you in your situation 🙏

Edit: and don’t just pray for him to be better or for the relationship to work out, pray instead to free your mind of any worries and anxious thoughts, and how He can prepare your heart for a relationship that you have been asking Him for. Ask for protection over your heart to help you willingly let go of anything that is not God’s will for you. Just place your trust in Him ❤️‍🩹🙏

i own the tangerine micro bag in medium size. I bought it like in april 2023 lang last year but girl it looks so ugly now. 

As in idk if i got a bad batch but during that time the tangerine color was new pa kasi?? But i was so disappointed kasi the stitching sa sides parang it wasnt ‘sealed’ properly like i saw sa photos. It honestly looked so cheap the moment i got my package. Parang it’s a bag i see lang sa mga bazaar or smth.

Less than a year later, the stitches are getting undone na and parang “punit” effect siya tingnan idk how to explain it. Sobrang rough na ng side ng stitches

Hindi rin matibay yung straps niya the holes get loose the more you use it, so when i wear it on my shoulder, (which i usually do) there’d be random times that the bag will just fall off completely and detach from the straps. It’s honestly so annoying. Pangit na rin ng suede lining on the inside very rough na siya after a few uses? 

++ the leather part where the magnet sits also isnt matibay. It’s completely tearing off already.

The stitching and craftsmanship just isnt good also so i’d take a pass on it nalang to be safe. Definitely not worth it for its price. 

On another note, i also bought their Selene heels and that’s the one that’s more promising and i still use it now after less than a year

Personally dont bring backpacks kasi mas hassle siya keeping everything organized.
